## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bc85776a87b852291c6dcea5d84bf6dfc28d7bb6`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` run once each in a detached read-only worktree at this head, so the ratchet reading in ③ is this seat's own; nothing built, nothing else run.

Read-only shape otherwise: the diff against the merge base 251a7dd4, card #21681 with every comment, the owning copy of the deleted line on `origin/main`, and this head's check-runs. Reviewed by the dispatch seat in seat (served tier equals the constant's value, read from `get_session`). Review face: `.claude/skills/**`, harness-loaded protocol text (Tier S). Readings taken at 2026-10-04T06:16Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged. Protocol prose in one per-fire references file (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`, +1/−1); no gate, label, script, schema or runtime behaviour moves. `Clause-②: no` holds. ⛔ No new gate, label or script, as the direction required.
- The direction's one sentence, read by this seat off the diff, placed in the grading section under the two close-at-grade lines: 「只报告仪器(放宽 tell、半状态巡查)的修复卡首触即关 not_planned,引裁决 208;在途只有删除。」 — a card whose fix lands in a report-only instrument (the widening tell, the half-state patrols) closes `not_planned` at first grade citing ruling 208, and its only in-flight work is deletion. 120 bytes against the 120-byte line cap; it cites no card number (`check-skill-id-lint`: 34 files clean, this seat's own run); the dispatch's suggested wording measured over the cap, so the explicit file pointer was dropped — meaning unchanged, both terms lead to `instrument-discipline.md`. The commit message names the two instances as the pin (#20969 / PR #21016, #21465 / PR #21679), as the direction asked.
- The payment, read by this seat: the deleted line 「立卡门四类:① 缺陷 / ② 维护者决定 / ③ 直派任务 / ④ 协调节点,⛔ 其余一律不立卡。」 is the filing door's summary, whose owning copy is `references/filing-gate.md` (the four-class line with its ⛔ and the four class heads beneath it); the pointer line kept directly under the deleted one (「首行写立卡门类别 ①–④;四类定义、⛔ 清单、三答与配额见 `references/filing-gate.md`」) keeps the reader on that path. The line entered as that file's summary with the filing-door PR (`37ed9ae0`) and moved here with the per-phase split that set this file's ceiling — a restatement, not a clause landed under a maintainer-ruled raise, so the ruled-clause precedent is untouched.
- Line reading: 120 → 120 (the seat's own count on the head blob); no re-wrap; no other file.

### ② Semver level

- No released package publishes from this diff (`.claude/**` ships nowhere); no changeset owed; `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration. No ADR-0087 disposition applies.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags: `open_questions` empty. `out_of_scope_findings`: the class is the instrument's role, not the file path (a hard-gate face sharing a file with a patrol is outside the sentence) — Acceptance notes, a reading the triage seat applies at grade time; whether PR #21016's landed code is deleted under the rule — the maintainer's, listed by triage, untouched here.
- Ratchet, this seat's own run at the head: every `.claude/skills/**` entry within its ceiling, `triage-duties.md` at 120 of 120 (headroom 0 as before); `check-skill-id-lint` clean.
- Deviation read: the wording shortened to the cap (stated in the PR's Acceptance notes); the `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` closure built under the lock so `check:doc-formula-expressions` could measure — recorded, no action; `mcp_calls` 0; `api_writes` 3 as listed; report comment 5977226069 present and parses.
- Check-runs on this head at this write: 15 success, 12 skipped, 2 in progress — the enqueue gate reads them at landing, not this record.
